name: Kaipara District Council
story: Kaipara District Council helped commission and distribute the 2003 Hokianga and Western Kaipara land-use assessment. NIWA and partner institutes combined climate, soil and crop information into regional suitability maps for council and community use.

sources.label: Griffiths et al., NIWA report AKL2003-037, March 2003
